description: Team ownership routing for inbound support messages.
question: which team should handle this message

boundaries.billing: charges, invoices, refunds, payment methods, pricing disputes
boundaries.technical: the product is broken or erroring for the user
boundaries.account: login, access, permissions, profile, data export or deletion
boundaries.abuse: spam, ToS violations, harassment reported about another user
_notes: 'charged after I could not log in' -> billing (the ask is the charge)
'cannot log in since the outage' -> technical (cause is an outage)
'cancel my plan, too expensive' -> billing (intent lives in intent_v1)
